rules.objective: Earn the most reward money by contributing capture points to outlaw melds over several rounds.
rules.gameplay: Players play sets and melds of outlaw cards, add to existing outlaw pursuits, and use action cards to change rewards or interfere. Rewards are paid according to contribution when outlaws are captured.
keyRules: Rummy-like meld play around seven outlaws.
Cards add capture points and reward money.
Action cards modify captures and scoring.
